applies_why: The judge text labels the point UNDERDETERMINED because there is no explicit textual resolution of paternity, which is the absence-of-explicit-statement ground K-S2 forbids.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: single verse does not state a link or its contrary: (1) it forbids an UNDERDETERMINED label based on lack of explicit textual resolution; (2) it forbids only explicitly relying on a single verse's silence, not weighing multiple verses.
why: The judge text grounds UNDERDETERMINED on the absence of explicit textual resolution of paternity, which K-S2 forbids because a single verse's not stating a link or contrary is not a ground for UNDERDETERMINED.
